record.foot_slip_contact_fraction_semantics: contacting-foot samples whose world-horizontal foot-speed proxy exceeds 0.35 m/s divided by all contacting-foot samples
record.base_height_semantics: vertical root clearance above highest of nine base-scan hits; invalid scan yields zero and safety stop

family_metrics.completed_step_index_semantics: number of registered treads whose exit boundary was crossed; 0 means none
family_metrics.per_step_progress_semantics: maximum reset-relative progress inside each registered tread interval, clipped to tread length
family_metrics.front_foot_collision_semantics: rising edge of horizontal front-foot contact force near a registered riser
family_metrics.stuck_or_catch_semantics: step interval with at least 25 low-speed samples within 0.05 m
family_metrics.swing_foot_clearance_semantics: minimum/summary foot height above the generated surface for non-contact samples
